import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re
from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import combinations
BLL=("MTMSLAPIRRVVTGHDAHGDAVIATDDALPTVVELAAIPGTIFHEVWSTAATPVSIDNGP"
     "DPTIGALRLPPPTHGTRIRFVDIPPDTEDFLKHGAARMKEAFSQVGDVHASTVRPDSPHP"
     "LMHRTETVDYGIVISGEITLVLDKSEANLKAGDVVIQRGTNHAWANRSGKPCRMLFMLVD"
     "GQFSDEVKPSRAGS")
LIG={"HIS":["ND1","NE2"],"GLU":["OE1","OE2"],"ASP":["OD1","OD2"],"CYS":["SG"],"TYR":["OH"]}
def parse(t,ch=None):
    return [dict(n=L[12:16].strip(),r=L[17:20].strip(),i=int(L[22:26]),
                 x=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])]))
            for L in t.splitlines() if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[16] in " A" and (ch is None or L[21]==ch)]
def detect(atoms,cut=3.2):
    cand=[a for a in atoms if a["r"] in LIG and a["n"] in LIG[a["r"]]]
    P=np.array([a["x"] for a in cand]); rid=[a["i"] for a in cand]; nm={a["i"]:a["r"] for a in cand}
    D=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None,:],axis=-1); n=len(P); best={}
    for i,j,k in combinations(range(n),3):
        if len({rid[i],rid[j],rid[k]})<3 or max(D[i,j],D[j,k],D[i,k])>7.5: continue
        c=P[[i,j,k]].mean(0); d=np.linalg.norm(P-c,axis=1); m=defaultdict(lambda:99)
        for q in range(n):
            if d[q]<cut: m[rid[q]]=min(m[rid[q]],d[q])
        if len(m)>=3:
            key=tuple(sorted(m)); best[key]=max(best.get(key,0),len(m))
    s=sorted(((v,[nm[r]+str(r) for r in k]) for k,v in best.items()),key=lambda t:-t[0])
    return s
S={"bll6423\n(AlphaFold, pLDDT 90)":("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q89GC2-F1-model_v6.pdb",None,"query"),
   "3ES1 cupin\nNovosphingobium\n38% id, 1.91 A":("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3ES1.pdb","A","rel"),
   "8X0V StrC +\nsubstrate analogue\n32% id":("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8X0V.pdb","A","rel"),
   "1FI2 oxalate\noxidase (Mn)":("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1FI2.pdb","A","ctrl"),
   "1UW8 oxalate\ndecarboxylase (Mn)":("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1UW8.pdb","A","ctrl"),
   "1JUH quercetin 2,3-\ndioxygenase (Cu)":("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1JUH.pdb","A","ctrl")}
R={}
for k,(u,ch,typ) in S.items():
    t=requests.get(u,timeout=180).text
    het=sorted({L[17:20].strip() for L in t.splitlines() if L.startswith("HETATM")}-{"HOH","MSE"})
    s=detect(parse(t,ch))
    R[k]=dict(n=(s[0][0] if s else 0), res=(s[0][1] if s else []), het=het, typ=typ)
    print(k.replace("\n"," "),"| het",het,"| best site",R[k]["n"],R[k]["res"])

PANEL=[("FdeH Hsero_1010 (ortholog, 67% id)","H Q H Q H H E D E Q T N H W"),
       ("A4XEC0 / 3ES1 (38%)","H H L - - H N D E Q T N H W"),
       ("oryJ Q2TXF5 (48%)",". . . . . H V D E Q T N H W"),
       ("phomC' A0A142I722 (37%)","H S H R S H E D E Q T N H W"),
       ("ascochitine-2 A0A5C1RFS2 (40%)",". . . . . H A A E V P S H V"),
       ("fogC P9WES6 (33%)","H E Y - - H V D V Q T A H W"),
       ("virC G9N4B0 (32%)","H E Y - - H V D E Q S A H W"),
       ("StrC A0A084QTE3 (32%)","H D Y - - H V D T Q T A H W"),
       ("srdD Q7SHI3 (30%)","L Q Y - - H M D V Q T A H W"),
       ("rusC W6R6H4 (29%)","N K Y - - H M D E Q T A H W"),
       ("srdB Q7SHI5 (29%)","H E N - - H L G E N A M H W")]
POS=["H15","H18","H44","H109","H119","H123","E126","D129","E137","Q157","T160","N161","H162","W164"]
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,6.4))
gsx=fig.add_gridspec(1,2,width_ratios=[1,1.45],wspace=0.32)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gsx[0,0])
ks=list(S.keys()); vals=[R[k]["n"] for k in ks]
col={"query":"#C2410C","rel":"#F59E0B","ctrl":"#1D4ED8"}
b=ax.bar(range(len(ks)),vals,color=[col[R[k]["typ"]] for k in ks])
for i,k in enumerate(ks):
    lbl=(", ".join(R[k]["res"]) if R[k]["res"] else "no site")
    ax.text(i,vals[i]+0.12,lbl,rotation=90,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=7.5)
    ax.text(i,-0.42,"metal in\nstructure: "+("yes" if any(h in ("MN","CU","FE","ZN","NI") for h in R[k]["het"]) else "no"),
            ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(ks))); ax.set_xticklabels(ks,fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("ligand residues converging on one point (< 3.2 A)")
ax.set_ylim(0,7.2); ax.set_title("Same detector applied to all six structures:\nthe canonical cupin metal site is found only in the controls",fontsize=10)
ax2=fig.add_subplot(gsx[0,1])
M=np.zeros((len(PANEL)+1,len(POS)))
rows=[("bll6423 (query)"," ".join(p[0] for p in POS))]+PANEL
txt=[]
for ri,(nm,s) in enumerate(rows):
    chars=s.split()
    txt.append(chars)
    for ci,ch in enumerate(chars):
        ref=POS[ci][0]
        M[ri,ci]= 2 if ch==ref else (0 if ch in ".-" else 1)
im=ax2.imshow(M,cmap=plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#E5E7EB","#FCA5A5","#166534"]),aspect="auto",vmin=0,vmax=2)
for ri in range(len(rows)):
    for ci in range(len(POS)):
        ax2.text(ci,ri,txt[ri][ci],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,
                 color="white" if M[ri,ci]==2 else "black")
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(POS))); ax2.set_xticklabels(POS,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(rows))); ax2.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rows],fontsize=8)
ax2.set_title("Residue conservation at every candidate ligand position of bll6423\ngreen = identical, red = substituted, grey = not aligned",fontsize=10)
for ci,p in enumerate(POS):
    if p in ("H123","D129","H162","W164"): ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((ci-.5,-.5),1,len(rows),fill=False,ec="#C2410C",lw=2))
ax2.text(len(POS)-0.3,len(rows)-0.1,"boxed = the four positions that in StrC (8X0V)\nline the bound substrate analogue",
         fontsize=7.5,ha="right",va="top",color="#C2410C")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
